subject: microbiology
title: Bile Solubility, Quellung Reaction and Pneumococcal Bench Confirmation

steps.tx: The **bile solubility test** adds sodium deoxycholate to pneumococcal suspension or colony: bile salts activate pneumococcal autolysin (LytA amidase), clearing turbidity and flattening colonies within minutes, viridans streptococci remaining insoluble. It is induced self digestion as identification, the draughtsman colony's chemistry demonstrated on demand.
steps.say: Bile wakes pneumococcus's own autolysin; the colony digests itself as proof.

left.title: Bile test mechanics
points: False negatives in old or capsulated strains

steps.tx: The **Quellung reaction** (Neufeld) mixes pneumococci with type specific antiserum and methylene blue: capsule appears swollen, refractile and sharply haloed under the microscope as antibody binds and changes its optics, serotyping strains for epidemiology and vaccine studies, latex agglutination and PCR serotyping its successors.
steps.say: Antibody makes the capsule visible as a halo; Quellung named serotypes for a century.

left.title: Quellung reading
points: Capsule halo sharpens with homologous serum
Omniserum pools narrow to type sera

steps.tx: **Pneumococcal virulence beyond capsule** includes pneumolysin (cholesterol dependent cytolysin, complement activator), surface proteins (PspA, PspC), neuraminidases exposing receptors, IgA protease, and pili in colonising clones, protein vaccine candidates because capsule replacement outruns polysaccharides. Pneumolysin also makes alpha haemolysis in anaerobic depth.
steps.say: Pneumolysin punches and prevaricates while capsule hides: proteins queue as vaccine candidates.

left.title: Protein weapons
points: Pneumolysin pores and classical complement activation

steps.tx: **Bench algorithm** for alpha haemolytic streptococci consolidates this and the previous lesson: optochin and bile for pneumococcus, salt tolerance and PYR for enterococcus (next lesson kin), grouping exclusion, and reporting rules (pneumococcus from sterile sites fully worked and called urgently).
steps.say: Alpha zone forks three ways: optochin, bile, then salt and PYR for the rest.

nodes.label: Optochin susceptible or bile soluble: pneumococcus
Grows in 6.5 percent salt and PYR: enterococcus

steps.tx: **CSF bench urgency** uses these identities at speed: gram positive diplococci in CSF Gram stain is pneumococcus until excluded and telephoned, latex antigen after antibiotics, culture and PCR parallel, susceptibility MIC by meningitis breakpoints. Bench minutes change empiric vancomycin decisions.
steps.say: Diplococci in CSF are a phone call, not a routine result.

left.title: CSF rapid stack
points: Antigen or multiplex PCR if antibiotics given

right.title: Meningitis differentials by Gram
points: Gram positive rods and cocci in newborn: Listeria, GBS

steps.tx: **Pneumococcal meningitis management** beside the bench: ceftriaxone plus vancomycin until MIC, dexamethasone with or before first antibiotic in many guidelines (hearing outcomes), repeat lumbar puncture selectively (no improvement, resistant MIC), neurosurgical and ENT sources for recurrence, vaccination and cochlear implant vigilance after.
steps.say: Steroid with the first dose and hearing in follow up: meningitis care extends past sterilisation.

left.title: Acute decisions
points: Do not delay antibiotics for imaging in classic presentations

steps.tx: **Invasive isolate stewardship** saves pneumococci for serotyping and resistance surveillance, because conjugate programmes are judged by which serotypes still invade (replacement versus failure). A discarded isolate is a blind spot in national vaccine policy, reference laboratories exist to receive them.
steps.say: Send invasive pneumococci onward; vaccine policy reads what benches save.

left.title: Surveillance questions
points: Outbreaks in care homes and prisons

right.title: Bench duties
points: Freeze or refer sterile site isolates
MIC for penicillin and ceftriaxone reported

steps.tx: **Quellung heritage** also typed the pre antibiotic serum therapy era (type specific antisera treated lobar pneumonia), reminding that pneumococcal identity was therapy before penicillin. Its capsule reaction remains the conceptual ancestor of every antigen detection kit in this curriculum.
steps.say: Serum therapy needed the type before the dose; typing began as a prescription.

left.title: Serum era
points: Type I and II antisera in lobar pneumonia

right.title: Concept heirs
points: Capsule vaccines target the same structures
